tolerance_basis: p99 of |r_t - (holdings_price_return + income_return)| over 708 account-days INSIDE the comparability domain apart from the excluded-weight ceiling (holdings status OK, no leverage, no negative value, same valuation interval) -- PRD v0.4 ruling 18. Over every day carrying a neighbour the denominator would be 1098.
comparability_max_excluded_weight_basis: DERIVED per TO-DB-b-1 amendment 6: tolerance / max(|band_low|, |band_high|) = 0.001244000 / 0.500000 = 0.002488000. Not chosen by this producer and not a percentile.

comparability_ceiling_effect.note: Days barred by the CEILING alone. The short-position member bars its own set and is counted separately in branch_counts -- the two are not added, because a day can fail both.

short_position_totals.basis: PRD v0.5 ruling 20. A short-position day is outside the holdings guard (ruling 18, because the neighbour's denominator is the LONG basket); one whose |F_t|/V_(t-1) also exceeds the tolerance is served as FLOW_UNRECONCILED / NOT_MEASURABLE, so this count is how many days round 1 declines to measure for that reason alone.

plausibility_band_basis: [-0.5, +0.5] daily as the PRD's default; the data's own p0.1 is -0.091352 and p99.9 is 0.044193, both inside the default, so the default stands unwidened.
large_flow_share_recommendation_basis: p90 of |F_t| / V_(t-1) over the 32 account-days that actually carry a flow, not over all 1098. The unconditional p99 the order names is 0.002535 -- a percentile of zeros. NOT SUBSTITUTED HERE: `large_flow_share` still carries the order's own rule and this is a recommendation beside it, because changing which population a served threshold is measured over is the issuer's call.
